query:
SELECT TABLE_NAME 
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES 
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
AND TABLE_NAME IN (
  'storylines', 'story_elements', 'cigarillo_recipes', 'cigarillo_recipe_ingredients',
  'technical_protocols', 'gcms_chromatograms', 'gcms_peaks', 'olfactive_experiences',
  'bibliography_entity_links', 'biosynthetic_pathways', 'gene_terpene_links',
  'soil_analyses', 'landrace_terpene_profiles', 'tobacco_cigarettes', 'tobacco_compounds',
  'ms_spectra', 'molecule_recettes', 'tabac_molecule_links', 'tabac_terroir_links',
  'landrace_pyrolysis_profiles', 'cannabis_landraces', 'tobacco_landraces',
  'perique_compounds', 'perique_fermentation_stages', 'perique_molecule_links',
  'historic_cigarettes', 'plant_perfumes', 'publication_molecule_links',
  'transformation_recipe_impacts', 'recipes'
)
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;
